answers.reason: The description states members take part only in the body where their own matters are decided, and the senate is for the whole university strategy.
The budget planning round is for the leadership and does not correspond to the faculty-level matters of a full professor.
An appointment committee selects candidates for a vacant professorship, which concerns the full professor.
The faculty council decides on faculty affairs, where the full professor holds their chair.
The study commission deals with degree programmes and teaching associated with the faculty.
The examination board handles examination matters of individual students.
The internal research funding round awards small grants for research projects relevant to professors.
Module revisions relate to degree programmes in the faculty.
Laboratory equipment procurement is for teaching laboratories in the faculty.
Orientation week planning is for new students.
